Option Compare Database

'------------------------------------------------------------
' DoImportCSV
'
'------------------------------------------------------------
Function DoImportCSV()

    With CodeContextObject
        ' Validate Input Data
        If (IsNull(Forms![Import CSV]![Account Name_box])) Then
            MsgBox "Account Name cannot be empty", vbCritical, "Error"
            Exit Function
        End If
        If (IsNull(Forms![Import CSV]![CSV File_box])) Then
            MsgBox "CSV File cannot be empty", vbCritical, "Error"
            Exit Function
        End If
        
        ' Try parsing CSV
        Dim acName As String, csvFilePath As String
        Forms![Import CSV]![Account Name_box].SetFocus
        acName = Forms![Import CSV]![Account Name_box].Text
        csvFilePath = Forms![Import CSV]![CSV File_box]
        
        Dim DataLines As Collection
        If acName Like "Fido*" Then
            Set DataLines = ImportFidoCSV(csvFilePath)
        ElseIf acName Like "Costco*" Then
            Set DataLines = ImportCostcoCSV(csvFilePath)
        'ElseIf acName = "Scotia Chequing" Then
        '    Set DataLines = ImportCustomScotiaChequingCSV(csvFilePath)
        'ElseIf acName = "Scotia Savings" Then
        '    Set DataLines = ImportCustomScotiaSavingsCSV(csvFilePath)
        ElseIf acName = "Desjardins Chequing" Then
            Set DataLines = ImportCustomDesjardinsChequingCSV(csvFilePath)
        ElseIf acName Like "Manulife*" Then
            Set DataLines = ImportManulifeChequingCSV(csvFilePath)
        ElseIf acName Like "BMO Harris*" Then
            Set DataLines = ImportBMOHarrisChequingCSV(csvFilePath)
        Else
            MsgBox "Unimplemented CSV type: " & acName, vbCritical, "SystemError"
            Exit Function
        End If
        
        ' Check start/end date
        If DataLines.Count = 0 Then
            MsgBox "CSV File is blank", vbCritical, "Error"
            Exit Function
        End If
            
        Dim MinDate As Date
        Dim MaxDate As Date
        MinDate = #12/31/2049#
        MaxDate = #1/1/1900#
        For i = 1 To DataLines.Count
            d = CStr(DataLines(i)("tranDate"))
            If d < MinDate Then
                MinDate = d
            End If
            If d > MaxDate Then
                MaxDate = d
            End If
        Next
        
        Dim MinDateStr As String
        Dim MaxDateStr As String
        MinDateStr = "#" & Format(MinDate, "mm/dd/yyyy") & "#"
        MaxDateStr = "#" & Format(MaxDate, "mm/dd/yyyy") & "#"
        
        Dim c As Integer
        c = DCount("ID", "BankCSV", "(Forms![Import CSV]![Account Name_box] = Account) AND ((StartDate <= " & MinDateStr & " AND " & MinDateStr & " <= EndDate) OR (StartDate <= " & MaxDateStr & " AND " & MaxDateStr & " <= EndDate))")
        If (c > 0) Then
            MsgBox "CSV Start/End Date (" & Format(MinDate, "yyyy-mm-dd") & " to " & Format(MaxDate, "yyyy-mm-dd") & ") overlaps with an existing record of account " & Forms![Import CSV]![Account Name_box].Text & ".", vbCritical, "Error"
            Exit Function
        End If
        
        DAO.DBEngine.BeginTrans
        On Error GoTo trans_Err
        ' Save to BankCSV
        Set db = CurrentDb
        Set rs = db.OpenRecordset("BankCSV")
        Dim bcsvID As Integer
        With rs
            .AddNew
            bcsvID = ![Id]
            ![Account] = Forms![Import CSV]![Account Name_box]
            ![StartDate] = MinDate
            ![EndDate] = MaxDate
            attachments = ![CSVFile]
            attachments.AddNew
            attachments.Fields("FileData").LoadFromFile Forms![Import CSV]![CSV File_box]
            attachments.Update
            attachments.Close
            .Update
        End With
        
        ' Save to Ledger
        Set rs = db.OpenRecordset("Ledger")
        For i = 1 To DataLines.Count
            Set dl = DataLines(i)
            With rs
                .AddNew
                ![TranDate] = dl("tranDate")
                ![Desc1] = dl("desc1")
                ![Desc2] = dl("desc2")
                ![Amount] = dl("amount")
                ![BankCSV] = bcsvID
                .Update
            End With
        Next
        
        ' Commit
        DAO.DBEngine.CommitTrans
        
        ' Finish
        If True Then
            MsgBox "" & DataLines.Count & " record(s) from " & Format(MinDate, "yyyy-mm-dd") & " to " & Format(MaxDate, "yyyy-mm-dd") & " are imported.", vbInformation, "Import successfully"
        End If
        
        Exit Function
        
trans_Err:
        DAO.DBEngine.Rollback
        MsgBox "RuntimeError during import: " & Err.Description & " - Line: " & Erl, vbCritical, "Error"
    End With

End Function



Private Function ParseCSVLine(line As String, Optional delimiter As String = ",", Optional quote_char As String = """", Optional escape_char As String = "\") As Collection
    ' States:
    '   0: Outside of a cell
    '   1: Inside an unquoted cell
    '   2: Inside a quoted cell
    ' Valid state transitions: 0->1, 0->2, 1->0, 2->0
    Dim Items As New Collection
    Dim Counter As Integer
    Dim State As Integer
    Dim Temp As String
    
    State = 0
    Counter = 0
    line = line & delimiter
    Do While Counter < Len(line)
        Counter = Counter + 1
        thischar = Mid(line, Counter, 1)
        If State = 0 Then
            If thischar = delimiter Then
                ' An empty cell
                Items.Add ""
            ElseIf thischar = quote_char Then
                ' Start a new quoted cell
                State = 2
                Temp = ""
            Else
                ' Start a new unquoted cell
                State = 1
                Temp = "" & thischar
            End If
        ElseIf State = 1 Then
            If thischar = delimiter Then
                ' Cell ends
                Items.Add Temp
                State = 0
            Else
                Temp = Temp & thischar
            End If
        ElseIf State = 2 Then
            If thischar = escape_char Then
                ' Pre-read the next char
                Counter = Counter + 1
                nextchar = Mid(line, Counter, 1)
                Temp = Temp & nextchar
            ElseIf thischar = quote_char Then
                ' If next char is also quote_char, this is an escape of quote char
                Counter = Counter + 1
                nextchar = Mid(line, Counter, 1)
                If nextchar = quote_char Then
                    Temp = Temp & quote_char
                ' Cell ends. Next char should be delimiter
                ElseIf nextchar <> delimiter Then
                    MsgBox "CSV not valid - delimiter should immediately follow the paired quote char. Line: " & line & " (Char " & Counter & ")", vbCritical, "Error"
                    End
                Else
                    State = 0
                    Items.Add Temp
                End If
            Else
                Temp = Temp & thischar
            End If
        End If
    Loop
    
    If State <> 0 Then
        MsgBox "CSV not valid - incomplete end of line. Line: " & line & " (End of line)", vbCritical, "Error"
        End
    End If
    
    Set ParseCSVLine = Items
End Function


' CSV import result should be a collection of dictionaries containing:
'   - tranDate: a Date
'   - desc1: a string
'   - desc2: a string
'   - amount: a decimal (positive=income, negative=spending)

Private Function ImportFidoCSV(csvFilePath As String) As Collection
    Dim DataLines As New Collection

    Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
    Set objStream = fso.OpenTextFile(csvFilePath, 1, False, 0)
    ' Skip header row
    LineFromFile = objStream.ReadLine
    
    Do While Not objStream.AtEndOfStream
        LineFromFile = objStream.ReadLine
        Set Items = ParseCSVLine(CStr(LineFromFile), ",")
        Dim dict As Object
        Set dict = CreateObject("scripting.dictionary")
        Dim ymds() As String
        ymds = Split(CStr(Items(1)), "-")
        dict("tranDate") = CDate("" & ymds(1) & "/" & ymds(2) & "/" & ymds(0))
        dict("desc1") = Items(3)
        dict("desc2") = Items(2) & " - " & Items(4)
        ' Minus the amount because it's credit card
        dict("amount") = -CDec(Items(5))
        DataLines.Add dict
    Loop
    objStream.Close
    Set ImportFidoCSV = DataLines
End Function

Private Function ImportCostcoCSV(csvFilePath As String) As Collection
    Dim DataLines As New Collection

    Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
    Set objStream = fso.OpenTextFile(csvFilePath, 1, False, 0)
    ' Skip header row
    LineFromFile = objStream.ReadLine
    
    Do While Not objStream.AtEndOfStream
        LineFromFile = objStream.ReadLine
        Set Items = ParseCSVLine(CStr(LineFromFile), ",")
        Dim dict As Object
        Set dict = CreateObject("scripting.dictionary")
        Dim ymds() As String
        ymds = Split(CStr(Items(1)), "-")
        dict("tranDate") = CDate("" & ymds(1) & "/" & ymds(2) & "/" & ymds(0))
        dict("desc1") = Items(4)
        dict("desc2") = Items(5) & " - " & Items(3)
        
        If Len(Items(6)) > 0 Then
            'debit
            dict("amount") = -CDec(Items(6))
        Else
            'credit
            dict("amount") = CDec(Items(7))
        End If
            
        DataLines.Add dict
    Loop
    objStream.Close
    Set ImportCostcoCSV = DataLines
End Function

Private Function ImportCustomScotiaChequingCSV(csvFilePath As String) As Collection
    Dim DataLines As New Collection

    Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
    Set objStream = fso.OpenTextFile(csvFilePath, 1, False, 0)
    
    Do While Not objStream.AtEndOfStream
        LineFromFile = objStream.ReadLine
        Set Items = ParseCSVLine(CStr(LineFromFile), ",")
        Dim dict As Object
        Set dict = CreateObject("scripting.dictionary")
        Dim ymds() As String
        ymds = Split(CStr(Items(1)), "-")
        dict("tranDate") = CDate("" & ymds(1) & "/" & ymds(2) & "/" & ymds(0))
        dict("desc1") = Items(2)
        dict("desc2") = Items(3)
        dict("amount") = CDec(Items(4))
                    
        DataLines.Add dict
    Loop
    objStream.Close
    Set ImportCustomScotiaChequingCSV = DataLines
End Function

Private Function ImportCustomScotiaSavingsCSV(csvFilePath As String) As Collection
    Dim DataLines As New Collection

    Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
    Set objStream = fso.OpenTextFile(csvFilePath, 1, False, 0)
    
    Do While Not objStream.AtEndOfStream
        LineFromFile = objStream.ReadLine
        Set Items = ParseCSVLine(CStr(LineFromFile), ",")
        Dim dict As Object
        Set dict = CreateObject("scripting.dictionary")
        Dim ymds() As String
        ymds = Split(CStr(Items(1)), "-")
        dict("tranDate") = CDate("" & ymds(1) & "/" & ymds(2) & "/" & ymds(0))
        dict("desc1") = Items(2)
        dict("desc2") = ""
        
        If Len(Items(3)) > 0 Then
            'debit
            dict("amount") = -CDec(Items(3))
        Else
            'credit
            dict("amount") = CDec(Items(4))
        End If
                    
        DataLines.Add dict
    Loop
    objStream.Close
    Set ImportCustomScotiaSavingsCSV = DataLines
End Function

Private Function ImportManulifeChequingCSV(csvFilePath As String) As Collection
    Dim DataLines As New Collection

    Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
    Set objStream = fso.OpenTextFile(csvFilePath, 1, False, 0)
    
    Do While Not objStream.AtEndOfStream
        LineFromFile = objStream.ReadLine
        Set Items = ParseCSVLine(CStr(LineFromFile), ",")
        Dim dict As Object
        Set dict = CreateObject("scripting.dictionary")
        Dim dmys() As String
        mdys = Split(CStr(Items(2)), "/")
        dict("tranDate") = CDate("" & mdys(0) & "/" & mdys(1) & "/" & mdys(2))
        dict("desc1") = Items(4)
        dict("desc2") = ""
        dict("amount") = CDec(Items(3))
                    
        DataLines.Add dict
    Loop
    objStream.Close
    Set ImportManulifeChequingCSV = DataLines
End Function



Private Function ImportBMOHarrisChequingCSV(csvFilePath As String) As Collection
    Dim DataLines As New Collection

    Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
    Set objStream = fso.OpenTextFile(csvFilePath, 1, False, 0)
    
    ' Skip 3 header rows
    LineFromFile = objStream.ReadLine
    Set Items_h1 = ParseCSVLine(CStr(LineFromFile), ",")
    Debug.Assert Items_h1(1) = "Account Type"
    LineFromFile = objStream.ReadLine
    Set Items_h2 = ParseCSVLine(CStr(LineFromFile), ",")
    Debug.Assert Items_h2(1) = "CHECKING"
    LineFromFile = objStream.ReadLine
    Set Items_h3 = ParseCSVLine(CStr(LineFromFile), ",")
    Debug.Assert Items_h3(1) = ""
    
    Do While Not objStream.AtEndOfStream
        LineFromFile = objStream.ReadLine
        Set Items = ParseCSVLine(CStr(LineFromFile), ",")
        Dim dict As Object
        Set dict = CreateObject("scripting.dictionary")
        ' format: Fri Sep 27 12:00:00 CDT 2019
        Dim wmdxxy() As String
        wmdxxy = Split(CStr(Items(2)), " ")
        dict("tranDate") = CDate("" & wmdxxy(1) & " " & wmdxxy(2) & " " & wmdxxy(5))
        dict("desc1") = Items(3)
        dict("desc2") = Items(8)
                    
        If Items(9) = "Credit" Then
            'credit
            dict("amount") = CDec(Items(4))
        Else
            Debug.Assert Items(9) = "Debit"
            'debit
            dict("amount") = -CDec(Items(4))
        End If
        
        DataLines.Add dict
    Loop
    objStream.Close
    Set ImportBMOHarrisChequingCSV = DataLines
End Function
